meta.defaultDescription: Independent web and mobile development studio. Marketing sites, e-commerce, web applications and iOS/Android apps — designed and built in-house.

hero.description: Web and mobile development studio. Marketing sites, custom web applications and iOS/Android apps — design and code by the same team, no templates, no outsourcing.

studio.description: You talk directly to the people designing and building your project. No middle manager, no offshore subcontracting.
studio.card1Body: Every project is built for your actual needs. Clean, documented, version-controlled code — the repository is yours from day one.
studio.card2Body: The mockups are made by the people who build them. Zero gap between the Figma file and the live site.
studio.card3Body: Core Web Vitals in the green, accessibility and technical SEO handled by design — not patched after launch.
studio.card4Body: FR · EN · ES. Internationalisation is part of the architecture, not a plugin bolted on six months later.
studio.statScoreCaption: Average Lighthouse score across our production releases.

work.empty: The first projects are coming very soon.

process.description: A detailed quote before we start, and a staging link from week one: you watch the project progress live, not in meetings.
process.step1Body: Goals, site structure, content and features. You get a costed scope, line by line.
process.step2Body: Figma mockups of every screen, desktop and mobile, signed off before any development.
process.step3Body: Build, back office, content in all three languages. Staging available throughout.
process.step4Body: Testing, redirects, back-office training, then maintenance and monthly improvements.
